''For the similarly named [[Amyrlin Seat]], see [[Anghara]].''

'''Anghar''' is in the [[Seanchan]] soldier in the army under the command of [[Furyk Karede]]. 

== Appearance ==
He has steady eyes.

== Activities ==
He is in a Seanchan unit that is on the way to attack [[Illian]]. When the [[Asha'man]] attack the Seanchan army, he rides back to [[Ebou Dar]] to report that they are retreating.
